Please make the case for this typing change in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) and get approval before filing a feature request, as required by the [feature template](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md). An earlier matching request is #4171, which was closed as not planned. The [table docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst) describe the title as text.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
